description: 列管廢棄物棄置場址 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 環境部環境管理署. 環境部針對國內列管廢棄物棄置場址狀況進行相關統籌調查及資訊掌握，本資料彙整列管廢棄物棄置場址座標、廢棄物種類、現場狀況等項目進行資料公開。 資料字典：CSID(案件編號)、City(縣市)、Dist(行政區)、Address(地址)、Cadastre(地號)、Site(場址名稱)、Lon(經度)、Lat(緯度)、WasteKind(廢棄物... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 環境部環境管理署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
